transcript: Hello, please sit. What problem are you having, tell me? Doctor, I have had a high fever for three days. I have pain all over my body and my head is also aching. The fever is rising. Did you measure it with a thermometer? It went up to 102 last night. I haven't taken any medicine yet. Okay, I am now seeing your temperature is 101.4. Pulse 96 BP 118 by 76. Do you have cough, vomiting, or loose stools? No, just fever and body ache. My throat is a little scratchy. Do you have any allergies to any medicine? No, I don't have any allergies. Doctor, please give me an antibiotic. I heard that if I take Azithromycin, it will heal quickly. No, this seems like a viral fever. It doesn't require antibiotics. Taking Azithromycin will not be beneficial; on the contrary, it could cause harm. I am giving Paracetamol 650mg. Dolo 650. Three times a day, three days after meals. And for the throat, Cetirizine 10mg. One before sleeping at night, five days. Okay, do I need to keep anything else in mind? Drink plenty of water. If you have difficulty breathing, or blood comes out of your gums, or red rashes appear on your body, come immediately. When will I come again? Please come after three days with the CBC test report.
